title: Never have i ever - Musik disc
description: a musik disc for the song Never have i ever by scott Frenzel
body:
Requires [a texture pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/never-have-i-ever-musik-disk) to work.

This dp adds a Scott Frenzel music disck with the help of a datapack. The musik disc is craftable using four planks and one iron ingot. it will play his song. this project is created for a a yt short.

[My Channel](https://youtube.com/@antzip2/shorts) here
